scripts.build: npm run build -w helper && npm run build -w extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w helper && npm run typecheck -w extension
scripts.test: npm test -w helper && npm test -w extension
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w extension
scripts.lint:ext: npm run build -w extension && web-ext lint --source-dir extension/dist --warnings-as-errors
